endings.name: ...And They Lived Happily After
endings.choice: Day 13, walk right and pay at the center ATM.
endings.result: The debt is paid. Do this one first if you want all three from one save.

endings.name: Let It Ride!
endings.choice: Day 13, walk left and take Double or Nothing.
endings.result: The coin is a win. Guides describe the crew’s money doubling.

endings.name: End of the Line
endings.choice: The same left-hand Double or Nothing.
endings.result: The coin is a loss. Community descriptions say the account is wiped and an execution scene plays. Spoiler detail, not an official script.

oneSave.caption: One save, three endings — Esc timing
rows: Reach day 13 with enough in the shared bank to pay. Take the right-hand payoff first. Do not flip the coin yet.
...And They Lived Happily After
The moment the achievement pops, press Esc and quit to the menu or close the game. If you watch the ending through, the late-run save can be overwritten.
Reload that same late-run state. Take the left-hand Double or Nothing once, and keep whichever coin you get.
Let It Ride! or End of the Line
Esc and quit again as soon as that second achievement pops. Write down whether the coin won or lost.
Reload the final-day lobby, before the choice. Change one thing at the shop: buy an item, reroll stock, or alter the item route. Do not change five things.
Setup only
You are not quitting from an ending here. You are moving the route, then going back in.
Return to the choice and take Double or Nothing again.
The coin result you still need
If the coin repeats, the shop action did not move the relevant state. Reload earlier and change a different single action. A brand-new save is the fallback, and it means playing the days again.

failures.caption: Failure modes
rows: You stay in the ending
The achievement popped, then the save moved on.
Esc out at the popup. The popup is the save point, not the credits.
Same coin every reload
Win, reload, win again. Or loss, reload, loss.
The flip is seeded to the route. Change a shop action before the choice. Clicking the coin harder does not reroll it.
Shop reroll does nothing
You rerolled and the coin still matched.
Players report this. Reload from earlier in the final day and change a different single action. Do not stack five rerolls and then guess which one mattered.
Payoff was never banked
You cannot clear the debt, so the safe ending is blocked.
Finish day 12 with the debt covered. The exact “full debt” check is community-reported.
Endless Mode is on
Day 13 never offers an ending.
V1.0.30’s patch notes say Endless Mode blocks the ending and the ending achievements. That toggle is chosen on an empty slot and cannot be changed after the save exists.
You did the bad ending first
The useful late-run state is gone.
Payoff first. Coin flips after. Protect the run, then break it.
